title: No-Kit Circuit
description: Three rounds of simple bodyweight moves with no equipment at all. A quick, steady circuit you can do anywhere.

title: Legs and Glutes Express
description: A short lower body circuit with one dumbbell and a resistance band. Two rounds that work the legs and glutes from a few different angles.

title: Glute Ladder
description: A fast glute session with a single resistance band. It starts lying on your back and finishes on all fours, with a good burn at the end.

title: Leg Day on the Mat
description: Yoga-style leg work with no equipment, using standing shapes and lunges to work the thighs, hips and hamstrings. A short seated stretch finishes it off.

title: Four Move Power Rounds
description: Four moves repeated in rounds with timed work and short rests, mixing weights and bodyweight into a full body session.

title: Light Weights, Whole Body
description: Light dumbbells for squats, rows and presses across the whole body, followed by a short core series to finish.

title: Road to the Splits
description: A 30 minute flow that opens the hips, hamstrings and thighs step by step, with blocks to help you settle towards a full split.

title: Slow Shoulders and Hips
description: A short, slow flow that loosens the shoulders, back and hips. A good lead-in to a longer stretching session.

title: Lunchtime Lengthen
description: A quick flow to shake off an afternoon slump, with lunges and standing balances that loosen the hips and wake you up.

title: Travel Day Unlock
description: Twenty minutes of hip openers and folds to loosen tight muscles after a long day of sitting or travelling.

title: Easy Morning Flow
description: A gentle flow that stretches and wakes up the body, linking breath with movement and ending with a short seated breathing practice.

title: Open Chest, Easy Spine
description: A mix of stretching and flowing that works on the spine and chest, for a freer upper body.

title: Quick Glute Shape
description: Bodyweight only: standing and floor work for the glutes and the sides of the waist, repeated on both sides.

title: Arm and Core Pilates
description: A short session low to the mat with light hand weights, building control through the shoulders, arms and core.

title: Barre Arm Finisher
description: Targeted work for the biceps, triceps and shoulders, with optional light weights. Bodyweight alone still gives a good burn.

title: Glutes at the Barre
description: A 20 minute barre session for the glutes and hamstrings, using a chair, a pillow for your knees and a few dumbbells.

title: Mat Barre Full Body
description: A longer, tougher barre session on the mat with a ball and light bands, keeping steady tension through the whole body.

title: Mat Pilates Basics
description: An introduction to classic mat work: controlled rolling, curling and extending moves that build into a few bigger shapes.

title: Wander and Wonder
description: A guided practice about slowing down and noticing what is around you, using the breath to settle.

title: Sleep Sound Bath
description: A soothing sound session to wind down the day and ease into sleep.

title: Settle the System
description: A calming sound session that lowers the pace, softens tension and brings the body back to a restful state.

title: Wind Down Stretch Flow
description: A gentle evening flow of wide folds and deep hip stretches to release the day before bed.

title: Night-Time Floor Stretch
description: Easy floor stretches, twists and hip openers to prepare the body for sleep.

title: Ocean Lullaby
description: A sound meditation with the rhythm of waves, to quiet the mind and help you drift off.
